facts.label: Food gives XP
facts.value: Blizzard says crafted food now gives a small experience bonus as well as stats.

facts.label: Well Fed
facts.value: Most buff foods give a 15-minute Well Fed buff plus 5% more experience from kills.

facts.label: Campfire
facts.value: The Cooking Fire is now a Basic Campfire. It creates a campsite with vendors, repairs, profession workstations and one-hour buffs you get by sitting at the fire. Camp buffs do not stack with class buffs. The first camp objects come from trainers or NPCs at skill 20; advanced ones come from blueprints that drop from dungeon bosses.

facts.label: Bigger camps
facts.value: The Basic kit (Cooking 1) holds 3 camp features, the Journeyman kit 5 and the Expert kit 10; the bigger kits need more Cooking skill. Each player can add one feature per camp.

facts.label: Camp rules
facts.value: Kits have a 5-minute cooldown, and all camp features share a 1-hour cooldown. Sit or craft nearby for about a minute and the benefits last an hour. Camps cannot be placed in major cities.

facts.label: Unlocking camps
facts.value: Camping unlocks around level 5 through a short questline.

facts.label: Skill ranks
facts.value: Cooking follows the same ladder up to 300. Artisan Cooking comes from the Clamlette Surprise quest at level 35.

facts.label: Journeyman Campfire
facts.value: The Journeyman Campfire blueprint drops from Lord Serpentis in Wailing Caverns.

facts.label: Cookie
facts.value: Cookie in the Deadmines drops the skill-140 Cookie's Feast blueprint and Cookie's Stirring Rod, a wand that gives +25% cooking speed.

facts.label: Favor recipes
facts.value: The Azeroth Commerce Authority also sells Cooking recipes for Merchant's Favor.

facts.label: Legacy perks
facts.value: Master Chef gives extra cooking results, Gourmand makes food buffs last longer, the Field Guide perk shortens the camp-feature cooldown and Reagent Economy removes vendor reagents for tier-1 camp features.

facts.label: Reworked raid foods
facts.value: Nightfin Soup now gives +22 spell damage, Grilled Squid and Hot Smoked Bass +1% crit, Mightfish Steak +40 attack power, and Baked Salmon and Lobster Stew +28 spell damage. Smoked Desert Dumplings (+20 Strength) and Dirge's Chops (+25 Stamina) keep their stats.

facts.label: Iron Oven
facts.value: Icy Veins says many raid foods, including Dirge's Chops, Mightfish Steak and Grilled Squid, also need an Iron Oven, a camp object that needs Cooking 300.
